question: Has Workday announced any restructuring recently? What are the details and expected costs?
grading: Reference-free (no fixed answer), graded for recency and support. Expect: announced 2026-09-29; reorganizations including a reduction of approximately 2.5% of the workforce, primarily in Product and Technology, plus select leased office space reductions; estimated charges USD 65M-80M (about USD 55M-70M in Q3 FY2027 and about USD 10M in Q4 FY2027); fiscal 2027 Q3 and full-year guidance reiterated except GAAP operating margin. Snapshot as of 2026-10-03.
answer: On September 29, 2026 Workday disclosed in an 8-K (Items 2.02 and 2.05) that certain functions announced reorganizations including a reduction of approximately 2.5% of its workforce, primarily within the Product and Technology team, and select leased office space reductions, while continuing to hire in strategic areas. It estimates charges of about USD 65-80 million, of which about USD 55-70 million in Q3 FY2027 and about USD 10 million in Q4 FY2027 (roughly USD 40-55 million future cash for severance and benefits, about USD 10 million non-cash stock-based compensation and about USD 15 million non-cash lease impairment). Workday reiterated its Q3 and full-year FY2027 guidance from August 27 except GAAP operating margin (now about 20-21 points below non-GAAP in Q3 and about 19 points below for the full year). [T16-E1, T16-E2] Separately, on October 1, 2026 Workday entered into a new USD 1.5 billion revolving credit agreement replacing its USD 1.0 billion 2022 facility; this is not part of the restructuring. [T16-E3]

output.answer:
**Question:** Has Workday announced any restructuring recently? What are the details and expected costs?
*As of 2026-10-03*

**Interpreted as:** 'Recently' read as events since the start of the current fiscal year, with emphasis on the latest reported quarter (Q2 FY2027, 2026-05-01 to 2026-07-31) and any 8-K/announcement in the last ~90 days. Workday's fiscal year ends January 31, so FY2027 runs 2026-02-01 to 2027-01-31; the latest reported period is Q2 FY2027. 'Restructuring' read as any announced workforce reduction, reorganization or cost-reduction program and the associated charges/expected costs disclosed by the company. Asked as 'Workday' — read as the reporting company Workday, Inc. (ticker WDAY), one company across its share classes.

| | Estimated charges (USD) |
|---|---|
| Total estimated charges (announced September 29, 2026) | $65 million to $80 million [1] |
| Portion expected in Q3 FY2027 (quarter ending October 31, 2026) | $55 million to $70 million [1] |
| Portion expected in Q4 FY2027 (quarter ending January 31, 2027) | $10 million [1] |
| Future cash expenditures for severance payments, employee benefits and related costs | $40 million to $55 million [1] |
| Non-cash stock-based compensation charges | $10 million [1] |
| Non-cash impairment of certain leased office space | $15 million [1] |

- Workday announced a reorganization on September 29, 2026, when certain functions within the company announced reorganizations designed to better align team structures with Workday's strategic growth priorities. [1]
- The actions include a reduction of approximately 2.5% of Workday's current workforce, primarily within its Product and Technology team, and select leased office space reductions. [1]
- Workday said it plans to continue to hire in key strategic areas and locations throughout its fiscal 2027. [1]
- The employee-related actions are expected to be substantially completed by the first quarter of fiscal 2028, subject to local law and consultation requirements, and the leased office space actions are expected to be substantially completed by the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027. [1]
- In the same 8-K, Workday reiterated its fiscal 2027 third quarter and full-year financial guidance provided on its fiscal 2027 second quarter earnings call on August 27, 2026, with the exception of GAAP operating margin, and said it now expects its fiscal 2027 third quarter GAAP operating margin to be approximately 20 to 21 percentage points lower than its third quarter non-GAAP operating margin and its fiscal 2027 full-year GAAP operating margin to be approximately 19 percentage points lower than its full-year non-GAAP operating margin. [1]
- Workday intends to exclude the charges associated with these activities from its non-GAAP financial measures. [1]
- No restructuring charges were recognized in the first half of fiscal 2027: restructuring expense was $0 for both the three months ended July 31, 2026 (Q2 FY2027) and the six months ended July 31, 2026, versus $1 million and $167 million, respectively, in the prior-year periods. [2][3]
- The American Bazaar reported that the job cuts will affect about 525 employees and cost the company $65 million to $85 million, with $55 million to $70 million expected to be incurred during the third quarter of fiscal 2027 and another $10 million recognized during the fourth quarter; the $85 million upper bound differs from the $80 million upper bound in Workday's 8-K. [4][1]
- The American Bazaar reported this is the second round of layoffs Workday has conducted in 2026, after laying off 2% of its employees in early February, primarily within its Global Customer Operations team. [4]

**Not available**
- Actual restructuring charges recognized in Q3 FY2027 (quarter ending October 31, 2026): Q3 FY2027 is still in progress as of 2026-10-03; the charges are only estimated in the September 29, 2026 8-K and no Q3 FY2027 results have been reported. [1]
- Number of employees affected as disclosed by Workday: Workday's 8-K discloses the reduction as approximately 2.5% of its current workforce but does not state an employee headcount; the ~525 figure comes from news coverage, not the company. [1][4]

**Sources**
[1] Workday, Inc. 8-K current report, items 2.02,2.05 (filed 2026-09-29) 8-K (www.sec.gov, 2026-09-29, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1327811/000132781126000048/wday-20260929.htm
[2] Workday, Inc. 10-Q for Q2 FY2027 (filed 2026-08-27) (www.sec.gov, 2026-08-27, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1327811/000132781126000044/wday-20260731.htm
[3] Workday, Inc. XBRL data tagged in 10-Q filed 2026-08-27 (www.sec.gov, 2026-08-27, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1327811/000132781126000044/
[4] Workday to cut 2.5% of workforce, affecting about 525 employees - The American Bazaar (americanbazaaronline.com, 2026-09-30, secondary) https://americanbazaaronline.com/2026/09/30/workday-to-cut-2-5-of-workforce-affecting-about-525-employees-489102/
